root_interpretation: A is the usable paving immediately in front of the main entrance stair, not the door's hinge or the master bounding-box center. The physical lowest stair point is annotated separately. All states use one density/camera, individual root translations only.
mask_authority: Current hand-authored content/factions.json. This conversion neither inflates the image nor weakens the mask. The final bottom-right blocked cell may contain little artwork; actual native footprint/pathfinding is unobserved.

owner_overlay.selection: One manually bounded primary cloth region per state; other blue architecture and decorative regional banners stay untouched.
owner_overlay.blue_cloth_rule: Within the annotated region only: alpha>16, blue>=35, blue>1.25*red, blue>1.08*green, red<130 and green<155. Gold marks and poles are excluded by hue.
owner_overlay.neutral_material: RGBA grayscale with gray=min(245,max(64,round(1.5*original_blue+32))); original selected alpha retained. This is palette processing of actual painted cloth, not newly drawn flag art.
owner_overlay.native_api: Explicit -OVERLAY sidecar, generateOverlay=0; clientsdl3/render/RenderHandler.cpp loads the sidecar for ONLY_FLAG_COLOR and MapRenderer.cpp applies owner color. Towns receive no automatic AF hero flag.

shadow.reason: The native map renderer requests a shadow layer. Normal native shadow generation is explicitly selected; painted contact shade remains in the master. Actual native projection and possible shade overlap require inspection.

edge_cleanup.method: At most four passes clearing alpha only on bright red pixels directly neighboring alpha-zero pixels. RGB remains byte-identical, interior colors remain untouched; raw masters and exact decoded portable copies retained.

icons.semantics: Only the own painted red X distinguishes normal versus built. It denotes native per-turn construction capacity consumed, not a different town, troop or fortification stage. Both retain otherwise identical decoded pixels.

acceptance: Technical native-size candidates only. No native pathfinding, ownership tint, shadow playback, final art or redistribution acceptance is granted.
